# Delighted

Delighted uses the Net Promoter System® to gather real feedback from your customers – in minutes, not weeks. No technical knowledge required.

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/delighted/.

## Actions

- **Add Person to Autopilot Email**: Add a person to Autopilot or update their properties for email-based surveys.
- **Add Person to Autopilot SMS**: Add a person to Autopilot or update their properties for SMS-based surveys.
- **Create or Update Person**: Create or update a person and schedule a survey email.
- **Delete Person**: Remove a person and all associated data from Delighted.
- **List People** (read-only): Retrieve all people for your account in creation order.
- **List Survey Responses** (read-only): Retrieve all survey responses for your account with pagination support and optional filtering.
- **Delete Pending Survey Requests**: Remove all pending (scheduled but not yet sent) survey requests for a person.
- **Get Autopilot Email Configuration** (read-only): Retrieve the current Autopilot configuration for email distribution.
- **Get Autopilot SMS Configuration** (read-only): Retrieve the current Autopilot configuration for SMS distribution.
- **List Autopilot SMS Memberships** (read-only): Retrieve all Autopilot memberships for SMS distribution platform.
- **List Bounced People** (read-only): Retrieve all bounced people for your account, ordered by bounce time (oldest first).
- **List Unsubscribed People** (read-only): Retrieve all unsubscribed people for your account, ordered by unsubscribe time (oldest first).
- **Unsubscribe Person**: Add a person to your unsubscribe list, preventing them from receiving any future surveys via email.
